assumptions: The annotations are the file author's; nothing here checks them against the authority they link to.
limits: NeXML only: Newick carries no taxon annotations, and NEXUS and PhyloXML annotations are not read.
An IRI value is reported as written; resolving an NCBI taxon id to a name needs the network.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the annotations the tree file carries, listed as written; nothing is inferred from them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this NeXML file say about each of its taxa?

description: Read what a NeXML tree file says about each of its taxa: every annotation on every OTU (an NCBI taxon, a rank, a parent taxon), one row per annotation, plus how many distinct values each property takes. This is the tip data the phylogeny canvas draws as a strip beside the tips, where a value that recurs further down is a group the tree does not keep together.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

nexml.description: a NeXML document (the text of a .xml tree file).

name: tree_taxon_annotations

annotations.description: one row per annotation: otu id, taxon label, property and value, in document order

properties.description: each annotated property with its count of distinct values
